gap: The When picker's calendar preview (and, on a clamped occurrence, the card chip, row and picker fields) put a Monthly series on the 29th-31st on the wrong day. The engine is right; what the app tells the person is wrong. SEED: clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York, desktop 1200x800, lists as in recur-check. things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Pay rent',when:'2026-03-31',project:'p_house'}] (no repeat). Route #/project/p_house. STEPS (real clicks): (1) double-click the row, click the card's When chip, click [data-action=repeat], then [data-action=repeat-type] > Monthly. Storage gets {mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'month'}, the section reads 'On day: Last day' and 'Next: Thu, Apr 30'. (2) Click the calendar's Later arrow page by page and read the .cal-day.rp-next rings. (3) Close the picker, then tick each occurrence on its own day (clock set to Mar 31, Apr 30, and so on). EXPECTED: the rings show the dates the rule falls on. CONTRACT: monthly keeps the anchor ('31 gives Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31'), and anchorDay makes 'the one after' the 31st again. Asana (NOTES, Preview): 'the calendar lightly highlights upcoming occurrence dates'. Also: 'When the to-do already repeats, the picker opens with this section showing its rule.' ACTUAL (3/3 clean runs, no page errors): the rings fall on Apr 30, May 30, Jun 30, Jul 30, Aug 30, Sep 30, Oct 30. The engine creates Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31. So 4 rings are on days the series never falls on, and May 31, Jul 31 and Aug 31 are never ringed. The same page contradicts itself ('On day: Last day' next to rings on the 30th). On the clamped Apr 30 occurrence (anchorDay 31), the card chip reads 'Repeats: Every month on the 30th' and the picker's On day field reads '30th', but its own note says 'Next: Sun, May 31'. The same happens for any Monthly or Custom-months rule on the 29th-31st (Jan 31 rings Mar 28), and for Yearly on Feb 29. CAUSE: repeat.js upcoming() passes the current to-do's anchorDay to every later nextDate call. It never carries forward the day each clamped step aims for (anchorDayFor, which complete() uses). repeatLabel, monthlyVals and kindDetail take the day from the date and ignore anchorDay. Script: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r8-c2/repro-monthly-31st-preview.mjs. ALSO TRIED, no break: I fuzzed nextDate against an independent oracle (200k cases x 7 time zones, including DST-at-midnight zones). I simulated store completion series (month ends, Feb 29, every 2 months from Dec 31, last Friday, completion-mode clamps, deadline lead, the Mar 8 and Nov 1 DST changes, year boundary every 2 weeks Mon/Thu, finishing late and early, ends after N or on a date). I compared the picker's Next note and first ring with the created date in 60 random UI runs (when null, today, evening, someday, past, future, Jan 31, Feb 28, Dec 31, Feb 29; clocks on the DST nights, New Year's Eve and a leap day; with and without deadline and reminder). I also did a random click walk over the Repeats controls on desktop and phone. All matched, with no page errors.
why: The calendar preview and the rule labels ignore anchorDay, so a Monthly-on-the-31st series is shown on the 30th/28th while the engine creates the 31st.
